people.name: Mohammed Abdellaoue
people.extract: Mohammed "Moa" Abdellaoue is a Norwegian former professional footballer who played as a striker. He started his career with Skeid and Vålerenga before moving to Germany where he played for Hannover 96 and VfB Stuttgart. After returning to Vålerenga he ended his career due to knee problems. At international level, Abdellaoue represented the Norway national team.
highlights: Played as a striker for Hannover 96.

people.name: Maggi Hambling
people.extract: Margaret J. Hambling is a British artist. Though principally a painter, her best-known public works are the sculptures A Conversation with Oscar Wilde and A Sculpture for Mary Wollstonecraft in London, and the 4-metre-high steel Scallop on Aldeburgh beach. All three works have attracted controversy.
highlights: Sculpted A Conversation with Oscar Wilde.
Created the steel Scallop on Aldeburgh beach.

people.name: Jonita Gandhi
people.extract: Jonita Gandhi, credited mononymously as Jonita, is a Canadian singer known for her work in the Indian film and music industries. Since 2024, she has performed as a solo pop artist by releasing her debut independent EP Love Like That.
highlights: Canadian singer in Indian film and music industries.
Released debut independent EP Love Like That.
Performs as a solo pop artist.
